sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Motion Picture International Copyright Distribution and Licensing

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-EU Free Trade Agreements and Double Tax Treaties

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L. 561-2 et seq. of the Code monétaire et financier (as amended by Law No. 2016-1691 of 9 December 2016), Décret n° 2017-924 of 9 May 2017 establishing the French UBO register, and EU 5th AML Directive (2018/843/EU)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French greffe or foreign corporate authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign documents or Consular Legalization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of UBO Identity, Address and Ownership
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority in country of origin

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against French TRACFIN/ AMF lists, EU consolidated sanctions list, UN sanctions, and OFAC SDN lists; PEP checks per AMF and ACPR guidelines

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: infogreffe.fr (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés - RCS)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All documents and company name must be in French; names must comply with French orthography and avoid any misleading or prohibited terms
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 'Banque', 'Crédit', 'Assurance' without prior ministerial authorization; 'Société Anonyme' reserved exclusively for SA form; general decency and public order rules
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If name rejected, administrative appeal may be filed before the President of the Tribunal de Commerce within two months of notification of refusal

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted for registered office address provided the provider supplies a physical street address and mail handling services; effective management and control must be demonstrable in France for tax and substance purposes
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low risk for standard low-risk SAS entities in film copyright licensing; unannounced inspections possible but infrequent under standard pre-incorporation protocols

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-Incorporation Legal Due Diligence and UBO Screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for corporate formation services plus prevailing market rate for AML/CFT compliance
Official filing fee plus administrative costs
Market benchmark for document authentication and legalization

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Office Setup and Virtual Office Lease
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Annual lease fee prorated for incorporation period

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Substance Assessment and Compliance Documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing hourly rate for substance analysis and DAC6 reporting

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce, Book II, Title II, Articles L.227-1 to L.227-30 and R.227-1 et seq. (Societe par Actions Simplifiee); Articles R.123-31 et seq. (registration in the Registre du Commerce et des Societes); Code civil Article 1832 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalites d'entreprises operated by the French business formalities network, filing with the Greffe du tribunal de commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts (Articles of Association) and Form M0 - Declaration de creation d'une societe par actions simplifiee
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for an SAS. The share capital is freely fixed in the articles. At least 50% of cash contributions must be paid up on incorporation, with the balance within five years. Cash capital must be deposited temporarily in a bank account or with a notaire and certified by a certificate of deposit before the registration file is submitted; no administrative escrow account is required.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founding shareholders having approved the statutes, including the free allocation of shares subscribed in the capital of the SAS, the share subscription is declared complete and each subscriber's rights are vested effective as of this date. RESOLVED, that the registered office shall be established at [address], France, and the President is authorized to complete any subsequent transfer formalities subject to statutory conditions. RESOLVED, that [full name] is unanimously appointed as President of the Company for an indefinite term, granted full corporate powers to represent the Company in all dealings with third parties, banks and public registries, with authority to delegate daily management within the limits of law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Signing the Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders and legal counsel; optional notarization before a French notaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bylaws in French, determine corporate name, registered office, share capital, share classes, governance rules and the corporate purpose of independent film copyright distribution. Ensure compliance with mandatory SAS provisions, then sign the articles by all shareholders or through an authorized agent.
required_dossiers: Original or certified passports/identity documents of all shareholders
Proof of registered office (lease, free occupancy agreement, or letter of authorization)
Capital allocation schedule and proposed share transfers
Draft statutes containing mandatory legal provisions
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any mandatory clause is missing or incorrectly drafted, file an amendment to the articles or a rectification declaration before proceeding to the capital deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any French credit institution or a notaire holding funds in a blocked account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary account in the name of the company in formation and transfer the cash contributions. Obtain a deposit certificate (attestation de depot de fonds) listing each subscriber and the amount paid, which must be delivered to the registering authority.
required_dossiers: Bank deposit certificate or notarial attestation
Bank account identification details
Shareholder identity and residency information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank imposes enhanced KYC measures and rejects the deposit, provide the requested supporting documents on ultimate beneficial owners or select another French bank or a notaire to hold the funds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Legal Publication of the Notice of Constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: A legal announcements journal approved in the department of the registered office, or the official online legal announcement service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and publish a notice of incorporation in French containing the commercial name, legal form, capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration and the name of the legal representative. Obtain the certificate of publication from the newspaper or service.
required_dossiers: Text of the mandatory legal announcement
Order confirmation and publication payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any information in the published notice is incorrect, issue a corrective notice and obtain a revised publication certificate before submitting the registration file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to the Guichet Unique and the Commercial Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique des formalites d'entreprises, transmitted to the Greffe du tribunal de commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete Form M0 online at formalites.entreprise.gouv.fr, selecting 'Societe par Actions Simplifiee'. Upload all statutory documents, certify the conformity of the file, and electronically sign the declaration. The portal routes the file to the Greffe for registration.
required_dossiers: Completed Form M0
Signed and initialed statutes
Certificate of deposit of share capital
Certificate of legal publication
Proof of registered office (lease, utility bill or notarial deed)
Identity documents and powers of attorney of signatories
Declaration of non-condemnation and management capacity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query for missing or inconsistent information, cure the defects within 15 days by submitting the requested documentation through the Guichet unique portal. If the corporate purpose is deemed unlawful, amend the articles and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Issuance of the Kbis Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce in the jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the registration file has been reviewed and accepted, the Greffe enters the company into the Registre du Commerce et des Societes and delivers an official Kbis extract evidencing the company's legal existence and powers of the President.
required_dossiers: Acknowledgement of the Guichet unique filing
Receipt for payment of registry fees
Any cure response submitted to the Greffe
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis is delayed, contact the Greffe through the portal to request priority handling. In case of refusal, petition the President of the Commercial Court under Article R.123-94 of the Code de commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Activation of Tax, INSEE and Social Identifiers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DGFIP (French tax administration), INSEE, URSSAF or the competent social security agency, and optional CNC registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the Kbis has been issued, activate the SIREN/SIRET numbers and the tax account through the official attestation portal. Complete employer registrations if hiring staff, and file any optional but recommended registration with the Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee for the film distribution activity.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract
Registered office proof
President's identity document and address
Bank account details
SIRET number activation confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax account or SIRET identifiers are not activated within the statutory deadline, contact the competent DGFIP center directly or file a request through the enterprise support portal; any procedural error may be corrected by resubmitting the Kbis and identity documents.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Centre national du cinema et de l'image animee (CNC) - voluntary professional registration for cinema distribution; Direction Regionale de l'Environnement, de l'Amenagement et du Logement (DREAL) only if a physical industrial installation is operated
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating license is required for independent film copyright distribution; voluntary registration in the Registre public du cinema et de l'audiovisuel may be obtained from the CNC as a professional formality to access film-sector support and financing advantages.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministere de la Transition Ecologique / Direction Regionale de l'Environnement, de l'Amenagement et du Logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - pure administrative and intellectual distribution activity without industrial production facilities; if an ancillary physical studio or screening space is opened, a prior declaration or registration under the ICPE regime may apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater or VOC thresholds apply to a standard office. If any ancillary physical activity is introduced, comply with the Code de l'environnement Articles L.511-1 et seq., including waste sorting under Article L.541-2, stormwater disposal rules, and local acoustic limits.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For the registered office and any ancillary workspace, submit a fire safety compliance declaration under Articles R.4214-4 et seq. of the Code du travail, obtain a structural load inspection certificate for any space open to the public within the Ierps category, and complete the workplace health and safety registration with the Service de prevention et de sante au travail, including occupational risk assessment and medical visit scheduling for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – French Tax Administration; Official Portal: impots.gouv.fr; Business Registration Portal: formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a French SAS, incorporation is completed through the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr). The company is assigned a SIREN number (9-digit tax reference) by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, and the DGFiP automatically attributes the intra-community VAT number (FR + 11 digits). No separate TIN application is required. A foreign entity without a fixed establishment in France must apply directly to the DGFiP using Form 1477 and appoint a tax representative; the SAS, being a French incorporated entity, follows the automatic registration path.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime in France. The SAS is compulsorily subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). Available elections: (i) VAT grouping (assujetti unique) under CGI Art. 256 C; (ii) tax consolidation (intégration fiscale) under CGI Art. 223 A for French-domiciled groups with ≥95% subsidiaries; (iii) reduced corporate income tax rate for qualifying small businesses; (iv) no hybrid mismatch election, as France has implemented ATAD-compliant mandatory rules.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT / TVA – Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No threshold for established French suppliers; VAT registration is compulsory from the first taxable transaction. The small-business exemption (franchise en base de TVA) may apply up to EUR 37,500 (services) or EUR 85,000 (goods) per annum, but this is an exemption, not a registration threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing reform effective 1 September 2026 for all French VAT taxpayers. E-invoices must be issued in a structured electronic format via the Public Invoicing Portal (Portail Public de Facturation – PPF) or certified Private Dematerialisation Platforms (PDPs) using API connectivity. Real-time transaction reporting (e-reporting) is transmitted to the DGFiP; no digital stamping is required, but a mandatory digital signature and 10-year electronic archiving apply.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are exempt with credit (zero-rated) under CGI Art. 262-1 where the exporter proves physical departure from France/EU via a validated customs declaration. For independent film licensing services, French VAT is outside the scope where the licensee is established outside France under the B2B place-of-supply rule (CGI Art. 259-1), resulting in a full input VAT recovery position. Eligibility requires a written licence contract, proof of the foreign counterparty's business status (VAT registration or tax residence certificate), and continuous export/royalty documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Déclaration d'Échanges de Biens / DAU)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for physical media exports)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Attestation de réception) or SWIFT MT103 confirmation
Licence and Distribution Agreement (proving rights transfer to a non-resident)
Certificate of residence / VAT status of the foreign licensee
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent use of the export zero-rating or outside-scope treatment gives grounds for retrospective assessment under CGI Articles 272 and 272 ter. The DGFiP may claw back all input VAT previously recovered, apply 0.2% monthly interest (Art. 1727 CGI), and issue a penalty of 40% for incorrect or bad-faith declarations (80% for intentional fraud) under Art. 1729 CGI. Criminal prosecution for tax fraud (fraude fiscale) may also be initiated, carrying up to five years' imprisonment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Direction Générale des Opérations and Direction des Statistiques Monétaires, Bancaires et Financières), acting with the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for banking supervision and the Direction Générale du Trésor of the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty for prudential policy and exchange-control coordination.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full currency convertibility for both current-account and capital-account transactions pursuant to Article 63 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. No general administrative approval is required for the payment of royalties, distribution fees, or profit remittances to non-resident shareholders or licensors. Statutory limitations apply only to distributions that would impair the SAS's share capital or mandatory legal reserves under the French Commercial Code, and to transactions falling under the foreign-investment screening regulation (Code Monétaire et Financier Articles L151-1 et seq.) for sensitive sectors. For a film-copyright licensing entity, profit and royalty remittances are considered fully convertible and are free from any domestic exchange-control permit, subject only to balance-of-payments statistical declarations and to the bank's AML/KYC verifications.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no mandatory surrender or forced conversion ratio for export receipts, including film-rights licensing proceeds. There is no requirement to convert foreign-currency receivables into euros; exporters may retain the funds in a foreign-currency account at a licensed French credit institution or convert at their operating discretion. The applicable statutory timeline under French Monetary and Financial Code and Banque de France instructions requires that proceeds from cross-border sales or royalties be repatriated to a French-resident bank account in accordance with the underlying commercial payment terms and the monthly balance-of-payments reporting deadline. Transactions exceeding EUR 50,000 must be declared to the Banque de France for statistical purposes; no specific amount is required to be surrendered to the central bank.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational EUR Account plus Segregated Royalty/Escrow Sub-Account
Operational Account and Licensing Proceeds Escrow Account
Commercial Banking Account for Treasury and Trade Solutions
Operational Account with Letters of Credit and Documentary Collections
Operational Account and Cross-Border Disbursement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium. A European Economic Area-licensed e-money institution or payment institution can legally provide the SAS with multicurrency IBAN accounts, SWIFT-style inbound flows, and card or SEPA rails, and may be a cost-effective supplementary channel for collection of sub-licensor fees. However, offshore digital EMI service providers are not viable as a primary treasury rail because they lack direct access to Target2, commercial letters of credit, and French clearing infrastructure, and the ACPR and French banks generally treat non-EEA EMIs as unregulated counterparties requiring enhanced due diligence. For film-copyright licensing involving significant international wire receipts, a regulated Tier-1 French bank remains mandatory for escrow, commercial LC confirmation, and credit lines.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical meeting with the SAS legal representative or at least one authorized director is generally required at the French bank branch for initial KYC and mandate signature when non-resident beneficial owners are involved. Remote onboarding using a certified electronic signature (eIDAS-compliant) and conducted via videoconference is now accepted by most Tier-1 banks for low-risk corporate structures, but the bank's compliance committee may still require one in-person identity verification visit by the director or the ultimate beneficial owner at a French branch or through the bank's notarial network. The film-licensing activity, if accompanied by cross-border intellectual-property payments, typically triggers a face-to-face interview before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident ultimate beneficial owner structure presenting an indirect film-royalty flow and perceived thin substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract of the SAS, certified corporate group chart, full UBO registry declaration, board resolutions appointing the bank signatories, tax residence certificates of all shareholders, audited financial statements, and a written explanation of the commercial rationale for the French holding entity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound lump-sum royalty prepayment or large one-time buyout of film distribution rights triggering source-of-wealth concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed independent film licensing/distribution agreement, ISAN registration certificate, chain-of-title documentation, external IP valuation report issued by an independent appraiser, invoice schedules, and banking reference letters from the payer's own monitored institution.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Counterparty located in a jurisdiction on the FATF/European Commission list of high-risk third countries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Commercial invoice and contract demonstrating a genuine film-distribution operation, sanctions/PEPS screening output, identification of the counterparty's beneficial owner, purpose-of-payment declaration, and an enhanced due-diligence questionnaire completed by the SAS's legal counsel.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Suspected artificial splitting of cross-border payments to remain below the EUR 50,000 balance-of-payments declaration threshold.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete cash-flow ledger showing aggregated monthly settlement, the bank's own transaction-monitoring alerts, contractual payment milestones, and confirmatory audit or legal attestation that each payment corresponds to an actual invoice.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant capital injections into the French SAS must be credited to the regular operational account through a SWIFT wire using the correct purpose codes: for shareholder loans and advances, use ECB BOP code 'L2S' (loans and advances from non-residents) or 'F1M' for equity capital contributions, as applicable in the French balance-of-payments reporting taxonomy. The inbound wire must include the SAS's name, tenant ID (numero SIREN), sentence 'Apport en compte-courant d'associé' or 'Augmentation de capital', and must be matched to the relevant shareholder meeting resolution and banked under the AML/KYC-approved counterparty list. For share capital increases, the funds must be fully paid into a blocked account opened for that purpose and must remain blocked until the notary or registrar issues the certificate of completion under the SAS by-laws.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade payments for film-rights acquisition, dubbing, marketing, or sub-distribution fees should be cleared via SWIFT MT103 for straight-through processing of cross-border wires, using the appropriate transaction purpose code (e.g., 'NRTR' for royalties, 'ICOR' for income on foreign direct investment, or 'TREA' for trade receivables). For high-value deliverables, a confirmed irrevocable commercial letter of credit (documentary credit) opened by the French bank in favor of the non-resident licensor or sub-agent provides settlement certainty, supported by inspection certificates, ISAN registration, delivery receipts, and invoice confirmation. Payments to French local recipients should be executed exclusively through SEPA Credit Transfer, and all cross-border payments above EUR 50,000 must be declared on the monthly Banque de France balance-of-payments reporting file.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forwards with a French-resident credit institution for EUR conversion of USD royalty inflows up to 24 months
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts permitted for currencies of non-fully-convertible markets, entered into through an MFI under an ISDA/CSA master agreement
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps for financing structures involving USD or GBP licensed revenue streams
FX options (plain vanilla calls/puts) for hedging contre-valorisation risk on future film-distribution advances

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements deposit (dépôt des comptes annuels) with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (via the INPI Guichet Unique, RCS system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after fiscal year-end the shareholders approve the accounts; deposit with the registry must occur within 1 month of approval and, in all cases, no later than 7 months from fiscal year-end (court extension possible)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil late-filing penalty of €150 per omission; criminal fine of up to €1,500 for an individual representative and €4,500 for the legal entity (Article L247-3 C. com.); the court may order a coercive per-diem fine and persistent non-filing can lead to administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax (IS) return package (liasse fiscale) and balance settlement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year company: online filing and final balance payment due by the 2nd business day after 1 May of the following year; for a fiscal year ending otherwise: within 3.5 months after the fiscal year close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 10% surcharge (after 30-day formal notice) plus monthly interest of 0.2%; the administration may carry out automatic tax assessment and enforce immediate recovery.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner (UBO) confirmation and update of shareholding transfers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) via the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the deposit of financial statements; any change in beneficial ownership (including share transfers) must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-disclosure or late update of UBO changes carries up to 6 months' imprisonment and a €7,500 fine for the legal representative (Articles L561-3 and L561-5 of the Monetary and Financial Code); repeated non-disclosure can trigger judicial strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholders' collective decision approving the annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate record; the signed minutes must accompany the accounts deposit and remain on-site
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The articles of association determine the meeting/written-consultation date; the decision must be taken before the annual accounts are deposited, and in practice within 6 months after the fiscal year-end to respect the 7-month registry limit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to approve accounts may nullify dividend distributions and expose the President to civil liability; persistent absence of approval may block the company's compliance proof and eventually lead to a court order to comply or strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A French SAS must appoint a statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) if it exceeds at least two of the following thresholds at the fiscal year-end: total balance sheet ≥ €4,000,000; net revenue ≥ €8,000,000; average number of employees ≥ 50. Even below these thresholds, the articles of association may require an auditor. For an independent film licensing SAS carrying only copyright-distribution and royalties activity, no sector-specific compulsory audit is imposed.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French statutory accounts must be prepared under French GAAP (PCG – Plan Comptable Général). IFRS may be used only for consolidated financial statements or where an option for listed entities applies; for a standalone independent film licensor, IFRS (IAS 38 / IFRS 15) is used as an interpretation guide for revenue recognition on royalties.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SAS must maintain an internal beneficial-owner register and file a declaration of beneficial owners with the RCS at incorporation. During the annual accounts-deposit process, the President must certify that the UBO information is accurate; if a change (e.g., a share transfer) has occurred during the year, an updated declaration must be filed with the RCS within 30 days of that event. The annual deposit of financial statements thus serves as the statutory annual UBO confirmation checkpoint.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of share movements (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of shareholders' decisions and minutes (procès-verbaux et conventions)
Register of beneficial owners (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard French corporate income tax rate for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit for SMEs meeting CGI Art. 219 conditions (turnover at or below EUR 10 million, fully paid-up share capital, not a member of a large group); research tax credit (CIR); innovation tax credit for software-related expenditure; patent box regime on qualifying IP licensing income at a reduced rate; parent-subsidiary 95% dividend exemption for qualifying shareholdings; no industry-specific tax holiday for independent film licensing.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_limit_years: Unlimited (indefinite carryforward; annual utilization capped at EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of taxable income above that cap; a separate one-year carryback option of up to EUR 1,000,000 exists)
